implementation: tools are fixed catalog entries and map to explicit API/procedure boundaries
JSON schemas reject unknown fields, oversize inputs, and invalid identifiers
each tool requires one application role and database role
tool inputs cannot carry SQL fragments or object names
tools do not accept callback or fetch URLs
MCP boundary exposes no shell, file, or process tools
correlation ID, identity, role, tool name, backing endpoint, and status are logged
caller identity and selected role flow into API authorization where supported
